headline: NASA dumped over 800GB of Artemis II data online
summary: NASA released over 800GB of Artemis II mission data online. The archive includes over 11,000 photos/videos and 8.5 hours of audio. Data is available on the Artemis II: Sights & Sounds of Science site.

headline: George A. Romero’s Season of the Witch is a slow-burn feminist occult drama
summary: George A. Romero, known for zombie films, also directed 'Season of the Witch'. This lesser-known film is highlighted as a slow-burn feminist occult drama. It was made between Romero's 'Night of the Living Dead' and 'The Crazies'.

headline: Vurt wants you to look at vertical videos as a genre of their own
summary: Major streaming services are experimenting with vertical content, inspired by platforms like TikTok. Vurt advocates for vertical videos to be recognized as a distinct genre. This trend reflects the competition for viewer attention in the streaming landscape.

headline: What to expect from Apple’s ‘Welcome Home’ event
summary: Apple's upcoming 'Welcome Home' event is expected to focus on smart home announcements. Anticipate refreshes for Apple TV and HomePod Mini, plus a potential new smart home hub. A new homeOS platform and partner devices could also debut.

headline: ‘I’m Shocked That People Are Still Playing’ – How GTA 5 Took Over the World
summary: GTA 5 has sold over 230 million copies, cementing its place as one of history's biggest games. Millions continue to play the game weekly, over a decade after its release. The article explores the enduring global success and longevity of GTA 5.

headline: Marvel Tokon DLC Roadmap Reveals First Look at Jane Foster Thor, Venom and Jubilee Coming in 2027
summary: Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls will add Thor (Jane Foster) to its roster this winter. The Year 1 DLC roadmap also confirms two more characters arriving in 2027. Venom and Jubilee are revealed as future additions to the game in 2027.

headline: Wildwood Review
summary: The review praises 'Wildwood' as an arresting and exciting fantasy epic. The game earns particular acclaim for its handmade and hand-animated quality. Despite its impressive aspects, some story stumbles occasionally hinder the experience.

headline: Godzilla Minus Zero Trailer Reveals Sneak Peek at King Ghidorah's Gravity Beams
summary: Toho released a new trailer for 'Godzilla Minus Zero', showcasing new kaiju action. The trailer offers a sneak peek at King Ghidorah's iconic lightning-like gravity beams. Godzilla's atomic breath is also prominently featured in the footage.

headline: Attack on Saudi Arabian airport is another dangerous moment in already tense conflict
summary: Houthi forces have intensified their attacks on Saudi Arabian soil. While physical damage is quickly repaired, Saudi Arabia's reputation for stability is being challenged. This incident marks another dangerous escalation in an ongoing tense conflict.

headline: Buildings swept away as flash floods hit central Nepal
summary: A flash flood on the Budhi Gandaki River has caused significant damage in central Nepal. Several buildings and bridges were swept away by the surging waters. This disaster comes just two months after prior catastrophic floods hit the country.

headline: Wildlife park remains closed after fatal tiger attack
summary: Yorkshire Wildlife Park is currently closed following a tragic incident. A man was fatally attacked after entering the tiger enclosure on Saturday. Investigations are underway to determine the circumstances of the fatal attack.

headline: Pope Leo to have surgery after lump found on lung
summary: Pope Leo, aged 71, is scheduled to undergo surgery. Doctors discovered a nodule on his lung during a recent medical examination. The pontiff stated that the lump was identified "at a very early stage."
